On 1F, most enemies are weak and have no special quirks.
Flutter flies, so physical attacks can't reach it.
Magium resists all kinds of magic.

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_2_2:
On 2F, many enemies are Airborne, and troublesome attacks
such as poison, fast strikes, and combos become common.
Harpy casts powerful spells. Skills that seal spells work well.
Hornet poisons with its sharp stinger. Be careful.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_2_3:

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_2_4:
On 4F, each enemy has specialized stats,

Sneak steals items, but you get them back by defeating it.

Warlock: Uses powerful magic.
Gargoyle: Airborne, but highly resistant to Thunder.

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_2_5:

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_2_7:
Why I Made a Dialogue-Driven RPG
I made this game as a dialogue-based RPG because I wanted to create
a light RPG that's easy to pick up, and to portray deep conversations
with a small cast of characters.
I hope that after playing, you'll come to love these characters,
and that this becomes a game you'll remember, even a little.
Short as it is, I made it hoping you'd grow fond of the characters
and their bond. Please, wish the two of them happiness.
"The casual conversations shared along the journey
will surely become special memories..."

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_3_1:
Clay's Skills
Mist Sweep: Drops an enemy's Agility to zero. Also helps set up combos.
All-Out Strike / Sweeping Storm: Powerful attacks, at the cost of
a debuff until your next turn.
Body Slam: Makes an enemy flinch once. Especially useful against few enemies.
Heat Haze Slash / Thunderclap Slash: Elemental attacks.
Shadowstep / Merciless: Deal heavy damage in combination with Sera.
They also raise TP.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_3_2:
Clay's Skills - Defense Commands
Shield Brace: Holds firm and weathers attacks.
Cover: Also takes attacks aimed at Sera. Takes effect immediately,
and even protects against attacks on all allies.
Taunt: Draws the enemies' hate, keeping their attacks focused on Clay.
Notes:
- Clay has a resistance that reduces physical damage by 20%.
- Against few enemies you needn't worry much, but on higher
difficulties you'll need to use defense effectively.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_3_3:
Sera's Skills - Attack Commands
Impedio: Blocks and seals magic. An enemy trying to cast that turn
is left unable to act. The effect lasts until the next turn.
Fractus: Inflicts Downed on an enemy at 1/3 HP or less.
Clay's Merciless deals massive damage to Downed enemies.
Letalis: Acts later, but deals Sera's highest physical damage.
Defense Command
Saltus: Makes Sera Airborne for one turn, evading physical attacks.
It also draws all enemies and inflicts Flanked on them.
Clay's Shadowstep deals heavy damage to Flanked enemies.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_3_4:
Magic doesn't just hit weaknesses. It also enables many combos.
Aqua: Inflicts Soaked on all enemies.
Glacies: Freezes Soaked enemies, leaving them unable to act.
Herba: Breaks enemy defense and inflicts Entangled.
Lux: Lowers all enemies' magic resistance.
Fulmen: Also strikes Soaked enemies. Deals more damage to Airborne foes.
Ventus: Lifts enemies with a gale, making them Airborne.
Ignis: Heavy damage to Entangled enemies.
Tenebra: Lowers the physical resistance of some enemies.
Combo examples:
Aqua > Fulmen: Soak them, then strike with lightning.
Aqua > Glacies: Soak them, then freeze them.
Herba > Ignis: Bind them, then burn them away.
Ventus > Fulmen: Launch them, then strike with lightning.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_3_5:
These spells also raise TP.
Healing Magic: Spells that protect allies' lives and restore their strength.
Restauro: Restores HP, and also cures physical ailments
such as Petrify and Frozen.
Cleansa: Fully cures everything from mild to severe poison.
Support Magic: Spells that draw out allies' strength in battle.
Furor: Attack up. / Scutum: Defense up. / Agilis: Agility up.
Support magic isn't strong, but it lasts 5 turns.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_3_6:
Bonus - Roles in Battle
Clay's Role and Concept
Powerful physical attacks: Strong enough to follow up on Sera's combo setups.
Support through defense: With his physical resistance, he can cover Sera
or guard, which also helps save MP.
Link Arts: The two can also unleash Link Arts in perfect sync.
Concept: A former mercenary. His sense of responsibility
and caring nature show in his concept.
Sera's Role and Concept
Versatile skills that exploit weaknesses: Skilled with many techniques,
she uses elements to hit weaknesses and sets up combos.
Healing and support magic: She can also use healing and support spells.
Indispensable to the adventure: Without Sera's healing,
this adventure simply wouldn't work.
Concept: The heart of healing and support, creating openings
to strike weaknesses. Someone this adventure can't do without.

An easy-to-use source of damage. Link Arts ignore resistances

1. Sera gathers enemies with a tornado

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_4_4:

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_4_6:
Bonus
Clay: Clay's skill names, such as Flash Strike, Rockbreaker,
and All-Out Strike, are based on rugged, Japanese-style names,
chosen to convey strength and an honest, straightforward nature.
Sera: Sera's skill names, both attacks and spells, such as Ignis,
Fulmen, and Lux, are based on Latin words,

Abyssal Demon
A fearsome demon that rules this dungeon.
It commands the depths, and gives off an eerie air

Its number of actions increases with difficulty.

Chaos Inferno: A powerful spell that hits all.

Can be removed with Restauro.
Maddening Gaze: Causes Confusion. Lasts 1 turn, but it's powerful.

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_5_3:
Orb of Light
A mysterious orb that slept beyond the dungeon's hidden passage.
It holds the power to summon the mighty warriors of history.
The Orb of Light fights by summoning servants.
It can't be damaged until its servants are defeated.
How often it summons depends on the difficulty.
At the highest difficulty, it summons every turn.
Knight of Light: A knight who uses skills like Flash Strike,
All-Out Strike, and Cover. The will to protect allies lives on.
It uses exactly the same skills as Clay,
and also has physical resistance, just like Clay.
Mage of Light: Uses attack spells like Aqua, Fulmen, and Glacies,
casting from behind its allies, who serve as a shield.
It uses exactly the same skills as Sera.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_5_4:
Orb of Light - Other Summoned Servants
The Orb of Light fights by summoning servants.
Listed here are its other servants.
Shrine Maiden of Light: A maiden who prays for her allies,
bringing the blessing of light.
She uses Invocation to heal one ally and Grace to heal all allies.
When no ally is hurt, she uses Blessing, which heals over time.
Invocation: Restores the HP of one ally.
Grace: Restores the HP of all allies.
Blessing: Restores allies' HP every turn for a set number of turns.
Lord of Light: The one who unites all servants,
embodying the will of light.
It launches powerful chain attacks with the other summoned servants.
The more servants, the stronger it gets. Like those of Clay and Sera,
its combo attacks strike first and pierce resistances.
Under the Lord's command, all servants join forces in a chain attack
of light. Its power grows with the number of servants gathered.

summoned along with the Orb of Light. Even after ages have passed,

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_5_5:
Orb of Light - Summoned Servants
Alchemist of Light: A seeker of the light's knowledge,
who blends the laws of the world.
Mixes unknown potions, inflicting one of four nasty ailments:
Headache, Daze, Despair, or Frenzy.
Headache: Deals damage over time.
Daze: Delays your chosen action by 1 turn.
Despair: Cuts HP recovery to 1/100.
Frenzy: Prevents choosing a target for your actions.
Hunter of Light: A pursuer of light who marks its prey
and never lets it escape.
A sniper servant who precisely pierces vital spots from afar.
Ambush: Attacks, then hides, avoiding physical attacks that turn.
Pinning Strike: A shot that takes the initiative and saps mobility.

@pic:add/secret_file/secret_5_6:
TP Boost Hints
Elemental Combos: Clay can also make elemental combos,
such as Herba > Heat Haze Slash or Aqua > Thunderclap Slash.
Follow-Up on Frozen Foes: Frozen enemies take more physical damage,
so follow Glacies with one of Clay's powerful blows.
Protecting Your Partner: Drawing enemies with Clay's Cover or Taunt
also raises TP.
Unscathed Heavy Strike: Sera's Letalis grows stronger if she
uses it without taking damage that turn, and it raises TP.
Combine it with Clay's defensive skills.
Healing and Support Magic: Healing Clay or using support magic
also raises TP. Healing with items does too.
Special State Combos: Hitting a Flanked enemy with Clay's Shadowstep,
or a Downed enemy with Merciless, greatly raises TP.
These states can be created by Sera, and enemies automatically
become Flanked just by attacking Sera.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_6_1:
About the Title
The game was originally titled "Labyrinth of Bonfires."
Its concept had a system of dungeons leading to rest areas
with bonfires, which gave it that name.
When the characters Clay and Sera were born, I wanted to put
the characters first, so I changed it to a title that brings
their names to mind.
"-rium" means "a place of," so I named it "Crescerium":
this dungeon, and this game, as "the place where Clay and Sera met,
a story that portrays their meeting."
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_6_2:
How It Started
I'd always wanted to try making a game, so I made an RPG.
Believe it or not, I first started it as
"a game I could make in a day."
But it kept growing bigger and bigger...
In the end, it took about three months.
While watching indie games and trending games,
I found myself wanting a game that could calm the heart,
one that portrays the depth of the bond between characters.
So I got to work.
I kept the characters and maps few, and made the dialogue
focus on atmosphere rather than volume.
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_6_3:
About the Battles
I never intended battles to be the main focus of the game.
But I didn't want them to feel like they got in the way
of the dialogue, so I tried to make them fun, with combos
that deal big damage and special moves to unleash.
In the end, the number of skills and monsters grew quite large,
but after tuning the higher difficulties, it all came together
as content to dig into, and I'm happy with how it turned out.
If you're reading this, you've probably cleared Difficulty VI,
so you must have truly mastered this game's battles.
I hope they were fun?
@pic:add/secret_file/secret_6_4:
About the Use of AI
Until now, even if you wanted to make a game,
it was very hard to do on your own.
But now that AI can help with graphics and programming,
my dream came true.
At the time I'm making this, using AI to make games
is still met with many mixed opinions.
What will the future hold?
Will it be accepted, or will handmade work become all the more precious...?
I look forward to seeing that future unfold.
